name: How soon can I re-list my property after an expired listing?

mainEntity.name: How soon can I re-list my property after an expired listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timing for re-listing depends on the terms of your previous agent agreement and the reason your property didn't sell. Once your previous contract has officially ended, you are free to engage a new agent. However, rushing to re-list without addressing underlying issues might lead to a similar outcome. It's often beneficial to take time for property improvements, a new pricing strategy, or updated marketing materials to present a fresh appeal to potential buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can re-list after your previous agent contract ends. Taking time to address issues and refresh your listing can improve chances for a successful sale.
